_readme: Capability map for the kipi-system SKELETON repo (not cole-gtm, which the CAP-01..45 Linear projects cover). Source for the Linear project 'kipi-system'. Status verified 2026-07-26 against: `python3 validate-separation.py 5` (170 PASS / 3 FAIL / 1 WARN), `launchctl list | grep com.kipi` (6 jobs loaded, exit 0), plugin.json versions, .claude/settings.json hook wiring, instance-registry.json (24 instances).

evidence.kipi_check: python3 validate-separation.py 5 -> 170 PASS, 3 FAIL, 1 WARN, exit 1
kipi_check_failures: Gate 1.2: No KTLYST references in scripts (1 file)
Gate 1.3b: Repository-derived generic targets contain no semantic instance facts (11684 findings)
Phase 1 sweep: Full skeleton sweep zero KTLYST/hardcoded refs (1 file)
evidence.kipi_check_warn: Skill-hook audit: skeleton has no manifest yet (advisory)

capabilities.name: kipi CLI
capabilities.summary: Single global entry point for every fleet operation. The founder never types a script path.
capabilities.entry: kipi (bash), dispatching to kipi-update.sh, kipi-new-instance.sh, kipi-push-upstream.sh, validate-separation.py, kipi-rollback.sh
capabilities.trigger: manual: kipi update | new | push | check | list | dev | rollback
capabilities.evidence: kipi:83,86 shells validate-separation.py with CAPABILITY_GATE_SKIP=1 for the instance path.

capabilities.name: kipi update (fleet propagation)
capabilities.summary: Pulls the skeleton into all 24 registered instances via rsync. The single mechanism by which a fleet-wide change becomes real.
capabilities.depends: instance registry, settings merge, leak gate
capabilities.evidence: 9 dedicated tests in q-system/.q-system/scripts/test/ (safety, dry-final-state, hook-contract, leak-preflight, preservation-failure, build-artifacts). Scar: --no-verify added 2026-06-15 (commit 2793992) after an instance pre-commit hook hung the updater.

capabilities.name: Instance registry
capabilities.summary: The list of what the fleet actually is. 24 instances, each with path, subtree prefix, instance q-dir, git status.
capabilities.trigger: read by kipi update/list/check; Phase 0 of the validator asserts every path exists
capabilities.feeds: kipi update, kipi check, capability gate
capabilities.evidence: validate-separation.py Phase 0: 24 instance paths PASS, 0 FAIL (2026-07-26).

capabilities.name: kipi new (instance creation)
capabilities.summary: Creates a new project with the full founder OS pre-wired, then registers it.
capabilities.evidence: Recent instances created this way: school-negotiator, interview-coach, norri-ai, thaena.

capabilities.name: kipi push (upstream promotion)
capabilities.summary: Pushes generic improvements from an instance back into the skeleton, so a fix found in the field becomes fleet-wide.
capabilities.trigger: manual `kipi push` from inside an instance
capabilities.depends: leak gate (must not push instance facts upstream)
capabilities.evidence: test-lessons-push-guard.sh covers the lessons slice of this path.

capabilities.name: kipi rollback
capabilities.summary: Reverses a propagation. Checkpoints each instance before writing and restores it on every give-up path.
capabilities.evidence: test-kipi-rollback.sh + test-kipi-rollback-matrix.sh in the capability manifest. Commit 8415b0d: checkpoint the instance and restore it on every give-up path.

capabilities.name: Settings merge
capabilities.summary: Merges skeleton hook wiring into an instance's settings.json without clobbering instance-local overrides.
capabilities.evidence: test-settings-merge.sh; settings-template.json ships 32 distinct hook scripts.

capabilities.name: kipi check (validate-separation)
capabilities.summary: The 6-phase validation harness. Gates skeleton integrity, model allocation, semantic containment, plugin version drift, and per-instance propagation.
capabilities.trigger: manual `kipi check`; also run before propagation
capabilities.evidence: RED as of 2026-07-26: 170 PASS, 3 FAIL, 1 WARN, exit 1. Failures: Gate 1.2 KTLYST refs in scripts (1 file); Gate 1.3b semantic containment (11684 findings); Phase 1 full skeleton sweep (1 file). This is the headline number for repo health.

capabilities.name: Capability gate (silent-absence class)
capabilities.summary: Catches the failure where a capability is declared but its test silently does not exist or never runs. Declared-vs-actual manifest plus a 3-convention test runner.
capabilities.trigger: validator Gate 1.2a; CI; 3 instance-side call sites
capabilities.evidence: Fleet-wide since 2026-07-23. Adding a test = one file + one manifest line. Commits 98cac94, 729dec9, 67f7dcc.

capabilities.name: Propagation leak gate
capabilities.summary: Stops an instance-specific fact (a client name, a path, a deal) from being copied outward into generic skeleton content during propagation.
capabilities.trigger: kipi update preflight; every path that copies generic content outward
capabilities.feeds: kipi update, kipi push, lessons propagation
capabilities.evidence: Armed at commit b8083b4, proven with a planted leak (843f438) then removed (c525503). Baseline holds 29 entries with a classifier_sha256 pin so a classifier change forces a restamp. 4 dedicated tests.

capabilities.name: Semantic containment (Gate 1.3b)
capabilities.summary: Asserts that repository-derived generic targets carry no instance-specific semantic facts.
capabilities.evidence: FAILING 2026-07-26 with 11684 findings. Needs a decision on whether the finding set is real leakage or classifier noise. Highest-count red in the repo.

capabilities.name: Plugin version drift (Gate 1.7)
capabilities.summary: Fails the check when a plugin's files change without a version bump, so the marketplace never ships silently-changed code.
capabilities.trigger: kipi check; compares working tree against origin/main
capabilities.evidence: Commit ac800a4. Gate 1.7 now delegates to the shared checker rather than reimplementing the rule (6b586f0). Sees the working tree (a6cd451).

capabilities.name: Model allocation gate (Gate 1.1b)
capabilities.summary: Validates every .claude/agents/*.md model: frontmatter against the tier tables, so agents cannot silently drift onto deprecated model IDs.
capabilities.evidence: PASSING. Scar 2026-07-01: the policy lived only as prose in 3 files while frontmatters drifted; no checker existed.

capabilities.name: settings-template sync check
capabilities.summary: Blocks the case where an enforcement hook is wired locally in .claude/settings.json but missing from settings-template.json, which would ship the script to the fleet with the switch dead.
capabilities.trigger: PostToolUse on settings edits; kipi update preflight
capabilities.evidence: Wired PostToolUse. test_settings_template_sync_check.py present.

capabilities.name: Instance automation guard
capabilities.summary: Blocks a script written into an instance's q-system/ subtree, where kipi update's rsync --delete would clobber it. Instance automation belongs at repo root.
capabilities.trigger: PostToolUse in instances; skeleton self-detects and no-ops
capabilities.evidence: RULE-2026-06-30-A. Scar: income scanners broke silently for 6 days because kipi update deleted their scripts. test-instance-automation-guard.sh.

capabilities.name: Hook and guard runtime
capabilities.summary: 34 hook entries across 6 events in .claude/settings.json; 32 distinct scripts shipped fleet-wide via settings-template.json. Every other enforcement capability is inert without this.
capabilities.trigger: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostCompact, Stop
capabilities.feeds: every enforcement capability in the repo
capabilities.evidence: Read live 2026-07-26. Highest fan-in node in the repo. Exit-code contract: 2 = block, 0 = pass.

capabilities.name: token-guard (circuit breaker)
capabilities.summary: The runaway-session breaker. 6 coded no-progress detectors plus a hard volume ceiling. Also the fleet's stand-in for a budget cap.
capabilities.evidence: VOLUME_CEILING=50, RETRY_LIMIT=3, AGENT_CEILING=30, MCP_RATE_LIMIT=30/60s, STALL_TIME_SECONDS=120. Volume ceiling resets on a real commit, so it gates lack-of-progress rather than raw volume. Fires in autonomous runs too.

capabilities.name: prompt-only enforcement guard
capabilities.summary: Blocks the repo's core anti-pattern: claiming a rule is ENFORCED when only prose backs it. Enforcement needs a hook, script, test, or validator.
capabilities.evidence: test_prompt_only_enforcement_guard.py + test-prompt-only-enforcement-guard-stderr.sh.

capabilities.name: wiring-check
capabilities.summary: Definition-of-done gate: no change is done until it is connected end-to-end. Catches text-in-a-file that the running system never loads.
capabilities.evidence: Scar 2026-06-20: a gap-class checklist was wired into an instance's plugins/ while the runtime loaded the marketplace clone. The edits were inert.

capabilities.name: Code-claim grounding guard
capabilities.summary: Stop-hook that blocks a session ending on an ungrounded claim about code.
capabilities.evidence: Commit 48adb50 (fleet grounding-guard Stop hook + fix voice-stop-gate || true swallow).

capabilities.name: Auto-commit and session logging
capabilities.summary: Stop-hook auto-commit so work survives a context loss or a parallel-session branch switch, plus async effort logging.
capabilities.evidence: Paired with the parallel-sessions scar: two sessions on one checkout yank each other's tree on a branch switch; auto-commit is what makes that recoverable.

capabilities.name: founder-voice skill + lint stack
capabilities.summary: The voice layer every externally-visible word passes through, plus the deterministic linters that catch what a prompt cannot.
capabilities.evidence: 4 wired scripts. Known detector gaps recorded: within-sentence comma triplets and cross-paragraph fragment chains were missed by voice-lint v1.

capabilities.name: AUDHD executive-function skill + lint
capabilities.summary: Every founder-facing actionable output follows executive-function rules. The one rule: if the founder cannot copy-paste it, click it, or check it off, it does not belong.
capabilities.evidence: Skill + paired hook, per the skill-hook pairing rule.

capabilities.name: headline-engineering + linkedin-brand
capabilities.summary: Two content skills, each blocked by a paired deterministic linter script (headline-lint.py, linkedin-format-lint.py, exit 2) for the parts a regex can actually catch.
capabilities.evidence: Both pairings listed as wired in .claude/rules/skill-hook-pairing.md.

capabilities.name: Format and batch-uniformity lints
capabilities.summary: The blocker scripts batch-uniformity-lint.py and format-lint.py (exit 2) catch the AI tell of uniform output shape across a batch, plus general formatting drift.
capabilities.evidence: Both wired in settings.json and settings-template.json.

capabilities.name: Skill trigger-eval
capabilities.summary: The runnable script skill-trigger-eval.py measures the one thing a regex lint structurally cannot see: whether an interpretive auto-invoked skill actually fires. It runs fixture sets of should_trigger prompts through `claude -p` and reports a rate.
capabilities.evidence: Deliberately never an exit-2 hook: it costs real model calls and the rate is noisy. test-skill-trigger-eval.sh.

capabilities.name: Memory auto-capture
capabilities.summary: Captures memory outcomes automatically at session end rather than relying on the agent remembering to write.
capabilities.evidence: Merged to main via PR #7 (5-issue gated flow) but gated OFF everywhere. Going live on 4_points means running the HELD kipi update, at which point the allowlist self-activates. Open spillover: sp-cac8540c (shell-read proxy tuning). 3 dedicated tests.

capabilities.name: Memory confidence
capabilities.summary: Blocks out-of-range confidence values and unknown provenance on auto-memory writes; surfaces low-trust memories at recall.
capabilities.evidence: Both wired. test_memory_confidence_validator.py, test_memory_confidence_surface.py, test_memory_confidence_wiring.py.

capabilities.name: Memory freshness (decay)
capabilities.summary: Surfaces decay:fast memories at session start for verification, so a stale fact does not get treated as current.
capabilities.evidence: Wired SessionStart in both settings.json and settings-template.json.

capabilities.name: Memory scores, outcomes, and reflection
capabilities.summary: Scores memories on use, records outcomes to an append-only log, and reflects over them.
capabilities.trigger: SessionStart (surface); called by the autocapture path
capabilities.evidence: Open thread: outcomes.jsonl has no compaction, snapshot, or retention. Judged premature for a log of tens of events; parked, not dropped.

capabilities.name: Cross-instance lessons corpus
capabilities.summary: HOW-only lessons distilled from real failures in one instance and fanned out read-only to the whole fleet. Titles surface at every SessionStart.
capabilities.entry: q-system/lessons/, lessons-validator.py, lessons-index.py, lessons-distill.py, lessons-daily.sh, lessons_scrub.py
capabilities.trigger: com.kipi.lessons-daily launchd job; SessionStart index; PostToolUse validator
capabilities.depends: leak gate (lessons must carry no instance facts), hook runtime
capabilities.evidence: 6 dedicated tests (validator, propagation, distill, scrub, push-guard, doc-wiring). launchd job loaded, last exit 0. Promotion rule: a lesson needs 2 unrelated instances; v1 accepts author self-attestation (provenance ledger deferred to v2).

capabilities.name: prd-os plugin
capabilities.summary: The gated PRD path: capture an idea, draft a reviewable PRD, run adversarial review, triage findings, split into issue specs, archive only when every accepted finding has a receipt.
capabilities.evidence: Archive is blocked until every accepted finding has a receipt. `prd_runner.py gates run` is the repo's registered no-bypass re-proof.

capabilities.name: kipi-dsse plugin
capabilities.summary: Issue execution with scope enforcement: edits are constrained to allowed_files, findings get per-finding dispositions, closeout needs receipts.
capabilities.evidence: Scar recorded in wiring-check.md: editing kipi-dsse's vendored copy of the codex:adversarial-review prompt was dead text; the live reviewer is the third-party openai-codex plugin.

capabilities.name: fable-discipline (execution discipline)
capabilities.summary: The coding-habit layer: recon before edit, verify against a copy with a negative self-test, single-writer chokepoints, scar-anchored why-comments.
capabilities.trigger: auto-invoke rule before any non-trivial code edit; /issue-start loads it for PRD work
capabilities.evidence: Merged into prd-os 2026-07-04 (was kipi-core). Deterministic slice enforced by the lint hook (test isolation); public mirror drift caught by export-fable-mirror.sh --check.

capabilities.name: Spillover ledger (no orphan findings)
capabilities.summary: Anything real but out of scope is captured to a file, never just mentioned in chat. The standing gate stays RED until it is resolved or explicitly voided.
capabilities.trigger: a deferred triage disposition AUTO-creates an item; gates run fails while any item is open
capabilities.evidence: Built for the ADHD failure mode: a backlog that lives only in a scrolled-past message is a silent drop. Two exits only: fixed with a closed-issue ref, or voided with a recorded reason.

capabilities.name: launchd fleet and liveness
capabilities.summary: 6 com.kipi.* scheduled jobs plus the watchdog that notices when one dies silently.
capabilities.evidence: Verified 2026-07-26: audit-rotate, fractional-cxo.bolt-on-discovery, fractional-cxo.opp-scan, launchd-health, lessons-daily, openloops-heartbeat. All loaded, all last-exit 0. Scar: income scanners broke silently for 6 days before this watchdog existed.

capabilities.name: Open-loops ledger and heartbeat
capabilities.summary: The parked-work ledger surfaced at every SessionStart, with an autonomous heartbeat that polls external state and pings only on a meaningful change.
capabilities.evidence: 7 open loops as of 2026-07-26 (1 live, 6 parked). Heartbeat wraps claude -p in `timeout 1800` (loop exit 4). test-open-loops.sh.

capabilities.name: Fleet loop board
capabilities.summary: The comprehension stand-in for a founder who will not read 162 commits. Deterministic board generated from git plus the open-loops ledger, published as an artifact.
capabilities.trigger: SessionStart nudge when the repo drifts from the published signature
capabilities.evidence: Republished 2026-07-26: 162 shipped/14d, 7 open threads, 6/8 exits solid. Self-disabling: no state file means the nudge stays silent.

capabilities.name: Loop-exit audit (8 exits)
capabilities.summary: Every loop is audited against 8 declared exit conditions, each pointed at a real enforcer rather than a prose claim.
capabilities.trigger: fires when building or auditing any phased/scheduled job
capabilities.depends: token-guard, prd gates, destructive-op hook, heartbeat
capabilities.evidence: Solid: goal-met, turn-cap, no-progress, human-stop, error-cap, external-event. On proxies: budget (call/rate proxy, no dollar meter is exposed to a PreToolUse hook) and wall-clock (timeout 1800, autonomous runs only). Documented honestly rather than papered over.

capabilities.name: Accepted-change rate
capabilities.summary: The metric that would say whether the autonomous loops are winning: what fraction of loop output the founder actually accepts. Below ~50% and the founder is doing the review the loop was meant to remove.
capabilities.entry: none yet; accept-rate.py exists but the loop path does not feed it
capabilities.evidence: Structural blind spot: open-loops-heartbeat.sh merges its own PRs under the autonomy contract, so there is no accept signal by construction. The fleet loop board is the stand-in until this is measured. This is the most important open gap in L8.

capabilities.name: Sycophancy harness
capabilities.summary: Computes the rubber-stamp metric pi = approved / (approved + modified + rejected) from the decision log, and alerts when recommendations are sailing through unexamined.
capabilities.trigger: SessionStart on the first session of each month; morning pipeline phase 6; manual standalone
capabilities.evidence: Alert threshold pi >= 0.7 with >= 5 tagged decisions. Scar 2026-07-01: the check only ever ran inside /q-morning, so an instance sat at pi ~= 0.88 and nothing could notice. Hence standalone mode plus the monthly hook.

capabilities.name: RCA skill and hooks
capabilities.summary: Root-cause analysis with a coded trigger: a hook taps you to open an RCA when a run fails, and a second hook validates the RCA's structure on write.
capabilities.trigger: PostToolUse on Bash watching for non-zero exit, FAIL, BLOCKED, or Traceback
capabilities.feeds: q-system/output/rca/, and often a follow-on PRD
capabilities.evidence: Enforces surface-vs-structural root cause, cause-type tags, evidence-backed verification, and blameless phrasing.

capabilities.name: learn-from-correction
capabilities.summary: Turns a founder correction into a durable change rather than a one-session fix.
capabilities.evidence: test_correction_outcome.py present.

capabilities.name: Agent pipeline and bus protocol
capabilities.summary: The 9-phase morning routine. Agents communicate through JSON bus files with schemas, not through context.
capabilities.evidence: Every bus file needs a producer, a consumer, and a schema. Verified by verify-bus.py, verify-orchestrator.py, verify-schedule.py, audit-morning.py, run-step-audit.py.

capabilities.name: Self-healing retry contract
capabilities.summary: What a running job does when a step fails: capture the error, ground against real artifacts, fix, re-run only the failed step, 3 attempts max, environmental failures stop at attempt 1.
capabilities.trigger: any step failure in a phased job
capabilities.evidence: Extracted 2026-07-01 from morning-pipeline.md where it was encoded while every other job reinvented or omitted it. A job claiming this contract with no coded cap does not comply.

capabilities.name: Claude agent definitions
capabilities.summary: 5 agent definitions with pinned model tiers and explicit tool allowlists.
capabilities.evidence: Gate 1.1b validates every model: frontmatter against the tier tables. Model IDs live only here plus the paired validator tables.

capabilities.name: kipi-design plugin + dogfood gate
capabilities.summary: Design skills plus dogfood_gate.py, the PostToolUse blocker script (exit 2) that stops a public page shipping when it fails the bar our own product sells.
capabilities.entry: plugins/kipi-design/ v1.2.4 (brand, design, ui-ux-pro-max), dogfood_gate.py, design-room skill
capabilities.trigger: PostToolUse on Write/Edit of a public .html; design-room before deploy
capabilities.evidence: Two layers: a fast deterministic tripwire on an embedded AI-default fingerprint, plus an authoritative design-room read. Scar 2026-06-20: the eyeball landing shipped as a slop-parody with the input buried two-thirds down, never run through our own tool.

capabilities.name: Plugin marketplace
capabilities.summary: 6 plugins published from this repo. The runtime loads the marketplace clone, not this repo's plugins dir, which is the single most-repeated wiring scar.
capabilities.evidence: Versions 2026-07-26: kipi-core 1.5.12, kipi-design 1.2.4, kipi-dsse 0.2.1, kipi-notebooklm 0.1.0, kipi-ops 1.2.0, prd-os 0.6.0. Known scope trap: kipi slash commands vanish when the install record is project-scoped to another project (fix: scope:user).

capabilities.name: Template repo build
capabilities.summary: Builds a clean public template of the founder OS for GitHub fork users, stripped of instance facts.
capabilities.evidence: test-kipi-update-build-artifacts.sh covers the build-artifact slice.

capabilities.name: capability-token (OSS contribution)
capabilities.summary: An approval-token primitive so an agent cannot mint its own grant. Offered upstream rather than kept as another standalone repo.
capabilities.evidence: Issue #14 filed at github.com/dwarvesf/claude-guardrails on 2026-06-20; waiting on a maintainer reply since. Patch and PR body are staged at q-system/output/captoken-*.  Phase 2 (Secure Enclave signing) would give real forgery resistance via a non-extractable key; parked.

capabilities.name: /say read-aloud + claude-voice mirror
capabilities.summary: Synthesizes the previous response to mp3 and autoplays locally. Also published as a de-kipi'd public repo.
capabilities.evidence: Scar: the slash-command sandbox blocks AppleEvents, so autoplay goes through `open -a Terminal`. Terminal + macOS only.

capabilities.name: research-mode and anti-hallucination
capabilities.summary: The grounding discipline for any claim that leaves the system, plus the scrapers that feed it.
capabilities.evidence: Unvalidated claims must carry {{UNVALIDATED}} or {{NEEDS_PROOF}}. test-firecrawl-scrape.sh.

capabilities.name: Granola voice harvest
capabilities.summary: Mines real meeting transcripts for the founder's actual speech patterns, so the voice layer is grounded in recorded speech rather than invented style rules.
capabilities.evidence: 3 scripts forming harvest -> fingerprint -> synthesize.

capabilities.name: kipi-notebooklm plugin
capabilities.summary: MCP wrapper driving a real Chrome via Patchright to query NotebookLM notebooks grounded on user-uploaded sources.
capabilities.evidence: Version 0.1.0 and no commands directory yet; the least-matured plugin in the marketplace.

capabilities.name: council (adversarial personas)
capabilities.summary: Multi-persona adversarial review that auto-fires on significant canonical changes, so positioning shifts meet dissent before they are written.
capabilities.trigger: auto on significant /q-calibrate changes, conflicting debrief signals, feature requests, competitive moves; Full Debate is founder-initiated
capabilities.evidence: Always Quick mode for auto-triggers. Skipped for minor edits and founder-dictated changes.

capabilities.name: Founder notification channel
capabilities.summary: One channel for every proactive ping: a Slack webhook that works headless and reaches the phone.
capabilities.trigger: called by any script detecting a founder-relevant event
capabilities.evidence: osascript desktop notifications are BANNED: they are permission-gated and silently dropped from a sandboxed or background process. Silent no-op when unconfigured, so callers never break.

capabilities.name: Rule registry
capabilities.summary: 31 path-scoped rule files. The blocker script prompt-only-enforcement-guard.py (PostToolUse, exit 2) rejects any rule that claims a behavior is held without naming a hook, script, test, or validator.
capabilities.trigger: auto-loaded per session; propagated to every instance by kipi update
capabilities.evidence: Counted 2026-07-26 by `ls .claude/rules/ | wc -l`. Root CLAUDE.md does NOT propagate to instances; a rule that must reach the fleet belongs in .claude/rules/, which kipi-update.sh rsyncs.

capabilities.name: Session continuity
capabilities.summary: Handoff, wrap, morning-state, and post-compact re-injection so a context loss is a checkpoint rather than a restart.
capabilities.evidence: PostCompact hook re-injects mode, loops, and voice reminders. /q-morning auto-detects a missed wrap.

capabilities.name: Quick-plan reflex
capabilities.summary: The fast path: the moment there is an idea, a bug, or a task bigger than one line, write a grounded plan.md before building. The plan is the checkpoint that survives context loss.
capabilities.trigger: founder pastes a bug/idea; any task larger than a one-line change not already in prd-os
capabilities.evidence: output/plans/ is excluded from kipi update sync, so plans stay instance-local. The plan is the agent's homework, not the founder's reading assignment.
